notes.title: Hole Punch is an upcoming physics platformer where you cut up the environment
notes.content:
Using a powerful dash you're not just avoiding people in Hole Punch, you're smashing through the level itself to get around the challenges.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/12/hole-punch-is-an-upcoming-physics-platformer-where-you-cut-up-the-environment
